description: Ship native SwiftPM macOS apps outside the Mac App Store, with Developer ID signing, notarization, GitHub Releases and Sparkle 2 updates. Use when setting up, running or debugging a Mac app's release pipeline, signing identity, notarization, update feed, release secrets or version bumps.
